Seven comments

An Damez Kohz

Heard this tune on Harry Shearer’s le Show, contacted him and found it was Capercaillie. Played as a fast waltz - about 165BPM (or 55 if you’re only counting on the ‘1’).

↳ Posted by LastPosted on December 30th, 2012.

Nice one!

↳ Posted by Dont on December 30th, 2012.

The name of this tune is An Damez Kozh and it is not a waltz, it is a “laridé 6 temps” or “ridée”. It is played by Gilles Le Bigot in “Empreintes#1” ( http://www.deezer.com/track/10008865 ), in a Emin key.
I learnt it from him in one of his workshops.
There are some errors in your sheet music but it is a good transcrition.

↳ Posted by Fabio Fiddle on July 5th, 2025.

An Damez Kozh, X:4

In this new posted version I changed the key of the variant from F#m to Am in order to avoid the G# which can be difficult to play on some instruments. The result still seems beautiful to me… the choice is yours. However I agree that it is a larideè and it would be good to write it in 6/4 (the accompaniment on ABC could be more appropriate).
Fabio
